pages: Dear customer, Thank you for choosing us for your HVAC needs. To assist our technician when setting up your new Lennox S40 thermostat account, and connecting the thermostat to your wi-fi network, please complete the information below: 1. The name of the wi-fi network to be used (2.4 GHz is preferred & not a guest network) _________________________________________________ 2. Your wi-fi network password ________________________________________________ 3. Name you would like your account to be listed as _______________________________ 4. Home address ___________________________________________________________ 5. Phone number for the account ______________________________________________ 6. What you would like the name of the system to be ______________________________ 7. Your e-mail address _______________________________________________________ 8. Password to be used for the account _______________________________ 9. Permission for remote access? YES or NO Our technician will leave this form with you after your account has been created. This will allow you to control your system remotely and your thermostat will receive any firmware updates as they are released. Refer to https://www.lennoxsmartertogether.com/help/index.html for additional information about your new Lennox S40 thermostat. Thank you
